An unmatched [ in image alt text is escaped so the image survives

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<img alt=\"[A;B)\" src=\"S\">", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
